# Flow

> Node graph editor parts that skin React Flow with Control UI tokens.

Status: experimental.

This file matches the installed `flow` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/flow.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/flow.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@xyflow/react@^12.12.0`
- `lucide-react@^1.47.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `button`
- `canvas-grid`
- `core`
- `motion`

- `@/components/control-ui/ui/flow`: `Flow`, `FlowBackground`, `FlowPanel`, `FlowControls`, `FlowNode`, `FlowNodeHeader`, `FlowNodeBody`, `FlowHandle`, `FlowEdge`, `FlowEdgeLabel`, `FlowEdgeLabelChip`, types `FlowProps`, `FlowBackgroundProps`, `FlowPanelProps`, `FlowControlsProps`, `FlowNodeProps`, `FlowNodePartProps`, `FlowHandleProps`, `FlowEdgeProps`, `FlowEdgeLabelProps`, `FlowEdgeLabelChipProps`

## Composition

### Node graph

```tsx
<Flow>
  <FlowBackground />
  <FlowPanel>
    toolbar
  </FlowPanel>
  <FlowControls />
  custom node type
    <FlowNode>
      <FlowHandle />
      <FlowNodeHeader />
      <FlowNodeBody />
    </FlowNode>
  custom edge type
    <FlowEdge />
    <FlowEdgeLabel>
      <FlowEdgeLabelChip />
    </FlowEdgeLabel>
</Flow>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import {
  type Edge,
  type EdgeProps,
  type EdgeTypes,
  getBezierPath,
  type Node,
  type NodeProps,
  type NodeTypes,
  Position,
} from "@xyflow/react";
import {
  Flow,
  FlowBackground,
  FlowControls,
  FlowEdge,
  FlowEdgeLabel,
  FlowEdgeLabelChip,
  FlowHandle,
  FlowNode,
  FlowNodeBody,
  FlowNodeHeader,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/flow";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

type StepNode = Node<{ title: string; detail: string }, "step">;

type StepEdge = Edge<{ label?: string; dashed?: boolean }, "step">;

function StepNodeCard({ data, selected }: NodeProps<StepNode>) {
  return (
    <FlowNode selected={selected} className="w-52">
      <FlowHandle type="target" position={Position.Top} />
      <FlowNodeHeader>{data.title}</FlowNodeHeader>
      <FlowNodeBody>
        <Text size="caption" tone="muted">
          {data.detail}
        </Text>
      </FlowNodeBody>
      <FlowHandle type="source" position={Position.Bottom} />
    </FlowNode>
  );
}

function StepEdgePath({ data, ...edge }: EdgeProps<StepEdge>) {
  const [path, labelX, labelY] = getBezierPath(edge);
  return (
    <>
      <FlowEdge id={edge.id} path={path} dashed={data?.dashed} />
      {data?.label ? (
        <FlowEdgeLabel x={labelX} y={labelY}>
          <FlowEdgeLabelChip>{data.label}</FlowEdgeLabelChip>
        </FlowEdgeLabel>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

const nodeTypes: NodeTypes = { step: StepNodeCard };

const edgeTypes: EdgeTypes = { step: StepEdgePath };

const nodes: StepNode[] = [
  { id: "trigger", type: "step", position: { x: 160, y: 0 }, data: { title: "New ticket", detail: "Support inbox webhook" } },
  { id: "classify", type: "step", position: { x: 160, y: 140 }, data: { title: "Classify intent", detail: "Model call, 3 labels" } },
  { id: "refund", type: "step", position: { x: 0, y: 300 }, data: { title: "Draft refund", detail: "Order lookup tool" } },
  { id: "answer", type: "step", position: { x: 320, y: 300 }, data: { title: "Search docs", detail: "Retrieval, top 5" } },
  { id: "respond", type: "step", position: { x: 160, y: 460 }, data: { title: "Send reply", detail: "Waits for approval" } },
];

const edges: StepEdge[] = [
  { id: "trigger-classify", type: "step", source: "trigger", target: "classify", data: {} },
  { id: "classify-refund", type: "step", source: "classify", target: "refund", data: { label: "Billing" } },
  { id: "classify-answer", type: "step", source: "classify", target: "answer", data: { label: "How-to" } },
  { id: "refund-respond", type: "step", source: "refund", target: "respond", data: {} },
  { id: "answer-respond", type: "step", source: "answer", target: "respond", data: { dashed: true } },
];

const FIT_VIEW_OPTIONS = { padding: 0.2 };

export function PrimitiveFlowExample() {
  return (
    <div className="h-140 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[var(--radius-panel)] ring-1 ring-border sm:h-150">
      <Flow<StepNode, StepEdge>
        aria-label="Support agent workflow"
        defaultNodes={nodes}
        defaultEdges={edges}
        nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
        edgeTypes={edgeTypes}
        fitView
        fitViewOptions={FIT_VIEW_OPTIONS}
      >
        <FlowBackground />
        <FlowControls fitViewOptions={FIT_VIEW_OPTIONS} />
      </Flow>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `flow`
  - `controls`
  - `edge`: `data-dashed`
  - `edge-label`
  - `edge-label-chip`
  - `handle`
  - `node`: `data-selected`
  - `node-body`
  - `node-header`
  - `panel`
  - `root`

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### flow

- `--cui-flow-background`: `var(--canvas)`
- `--cui-flow-grid-dot-color`: `var(--canvas-grid-dot)`
- `--cui-flow-edge-stroke`: `oklch(from var(--muted-foreground) l c h / 0.6)`
- `--cui-flow-selected-edge-stroke`: `var(--primary)`
- `--cui-flow-edge-size`: `1.5px`
- `--cui-flow-node-background`: `var(--card)`
- `--cui-flow-node-foreground`: `var(--card-foreground)`
- `--cui-flow-node-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-flow-node-hover-border-color`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.2)`
- `--cui-flow-node-selected-border-color`: `var(--primary)`
- `--cui-flow-node-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-flow-node-body-background`: `transparent`
- `--cui-flow-node-body-radius`: `0px`
- `--cui-flow-node-body-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)`
- `--cui-flow-node-body-padding-block`: `0px`
- `--cui-flow-node-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)`
- `--cui-flow-node-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)`
- `--cui-flow-handle-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`
- `--cui-flow-handle-background`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-flow-handle-border-color`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-flow-handle-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-flow-handle-radius`: `9999px`
- `--cui-flow-edge-label-background`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-flow-edge-label-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-flow-edge-label-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-flow-edge-label-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-flow-edge-label-radius`: `9999px`
- `--cui-flow-controls-item-radius`: `min(var(--radius-sm), calc(var(--control-h-sm) / 2))`
- `--cui-flow-controls-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1)`
- `--cui-flow-controls-radius`: `calc(
      var(--cui-flow-controls-item-radius) +
      clamp(0px, calc(var(--cui-flow-controls-item-radius) * 1000), var(--cui-flow-controls-padding))
    )`
- `--cui-flow-controls-background`: `var(--card)`
- `--cui-flow-controls-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-flow-controls-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)`
